value.behaviour: Export arrowhead size preset scale multipliers, type, default value, and validator from @excalidraw/common.
rules: 1. Define export const ARROWHEAD_SIZES = { sm: 0.5, md: 0.75, lg: 1, xl: 1.25 } as const right after FONT_SIZES.
2. Define export type ArrowheadSize = (typeof ARROWHEAD_SIZES)[keyof typeof ARROWHEAD_SIZES].
3. Define export const DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE: ArrowheadSize = ARROWHEAD_SIZES.lg.

4. Define export const isValidArrowheadSize = (value: unknown): value is ArrowheadSize => value === ARROWHEAD_SIZES.sm || value === ARROWHEAD_SIZES.md || value === ARROWHEAD_SIZES.lg || value === ARROWHEAD_SIZES.xl.

exports.returns: { readonly sm: 0.5; readonly md: 0.75; readonly lg: 1; readonly xl: 1.25 }

rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE from @excalidraw/common.

2. In mutateElement, when key === "arrowheadSize" and (value === undefined || value === DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE), if "arrowheadSize" in element then delete (element as any).arrowheadSize and set didChange = true, then continue; also include "arrowheadSize" in updates in the ShapeCache.delete(element) condition.

3. In newElementWith, for key === "arrowheadSize", normalize the target value as const nextArrowheadSize = value === DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE ? undefined : value and only set didChange = true when (element as any).arrowheadSize !== nextArrowheadSize; before returning the cloned object, if "arrowheadSize" in nextElement && (nextElement.arrowheadSize === undefined || nextElement.arrowheadSize === DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE), delete nextElement.arrowheadSize.

value.behaviour: Scale arrowhead size, angle widening thresholds, and cardinality/short-segment geometry by element.arrowheadSize, and extend linear element bounds with uncached arrowhead extents only when arrowheadSize exceeds DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE from @excalidraw/common and ArrowheadSize from ./types.

2. Update getArrowheadSize(arrowhead: Arrowhead, size: ArrowheadSize = DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE): number to multiply the returned per-type pixel size (25, 12, CROWFOOT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE, CARDINALITY_MARKER_SIZE, 15) by size.

3. Update getArrowheadAngle(arrowhead: Arrowhead, size?: number, arrowheadSize: ArrowheadSize = DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE): Degrees with const resolvedSize = size ?? getArrowheadSize(arrowhead, arrowheadSize) in the body so case "arrow": computes const fullSize = getArrowheadSize(arrowhead, arrowheadSize); const widestSize = ARROW_ARROWHEAD_WIDEST_SIZE * arrowheadSize; const shrinkage = clamp((fullSize - resolvedSize) / (fullSize - widestSize), 0, 1); keeping the 20deg angle at every size unless shrunk by short-segment fitting.

4. Add optional arrowheadSize: ArrowheadSize = DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE parameter to getCardinalityMarkerScale and pass arrowheadSize into getArrowheadAngle("cardinality_one", undefined, arrowheadSize), getArrowheadSize("cardinality_one", arrowheadSize), getArrowheadSize("cardinality_many", arrowheadSize), and getArrowheadSize("circle_outline", arrowheadSize).

5. In getArrowheadSizeBeyondLastSegment, pass element.arrowheadSize to getArrowheadSize(arrowhead, element.arrowheadSize), getCardinalityMarkerScale(marker, corner, element.strokeWidth, element.arrowheadSize), getArrowheadAngle(arrowhead, undefined, element.arrowheadSize), legibleSize = getArrowheadSize(arrowhead, element.arrowheadSize) / 2, getArrowheadAngle(arrowhead, legibleSize, element.arrowheadSize), and getArrowheadAngle(arrowhead, 0, element.arrowheadSize).
6. In getArrowheadPoints, compute const size = getArrowheadSize(arrowhead, element.arrowheadSize); and const angle = getArrowheadAngle(arrowhead, minSize, element.arrowheadSize);.

7. In getLinearElementRotatedBounds, keep the existing line-only bounds calculation (lines 1223-1234) unchanged for sizes at or below DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE; after let coords: Bounds = [res[0], res[1], res[2], res[3]];, when (element.arrowheadSize ?? DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE) > DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE && (element.startArrowhead || element.endArrowhead), build const curveShape = [generateLinearElementShape(element)]; (never reading ShapeCache) and for each non-null [position, arrowhead] of [["start", element.startArrowhead], ["end", element.endArrowhead]] as const, compute const pts = getArrowheadPoints(element, curveShape, position, arrowhead); if pts is non-null, for "circle" | "circle_outline" transform [pts[0], pts[1]] via transformXY and extend coords by radius = pts[2] / 2 around the rotated center, and for all other arrowheads iterate point pairs (i += 2) transforming [pts[i], pts[i + 1]] via transformXY and extending coords.
